top_story.headline: Former Vice President adviser registers to lobby for a company with a foreign parent entity
top_story.dek: Continental Strategy's new registration for Future Pipe Industries lists a former Special Advisor to the Vice President as a covered position.
paragraphs: Continental Strategy, LLC registered to lobby for Future Pipe Industries LLC, a fiberglass pipe manufacturer, on U.S. composite pipe manufacturing and energy infrastructure. The issue areas are budget and appropriations, clean air and water, energy and nuclear, fuel, gas and oil, manufacturing, and trade. Registration.

The filing lists Wessam Hassanein, whose covered position is "Special Advisor to the Vice President," and names Future Group Holdings SA SPF as a foreign entity. The input gives no dates for his government service. Continental Strategy filed a second registration the same day, for Treaty Oak Clean Energy LLC, which lists no covered positions or foreign entities. Registration.

sections.headline: 24 new registrations and 20 terminations, led by former-official hires and a foreign-entity link
paragraphs: 443 filings posted since November 3: 301 third-quarter reports, 64 third-quarter no-activity reports, 24 registrations, 14 third-quarter amendments, 11 second-quarter amendments, 9 third-quarter terminations, 9 third-quarter no-activity terminations, and a scattering of other amendments and terminations.

Registrations with former government officials include Steptoe LLP (a former Deputy Assistant to the President) and Continental Strategy, LLC (a former Vice President adviser). Two registrations name foreign entities: Continental Strategy for Future Pipe Industries and Venable LLP for a pipeline coalition. Other activity reports with a signal are listed below, including conviction disclosures and a recurring theme of tribal lobbying on CFTC event contracts. The remaining signal-flagged and routine activity reports are left out.
